title: [Master]- Create Documents on Recurring Billing ignores the Partner filter and fails when a vendor billing proposal exists
summary: Create Documents in Recurring Billing now respects the Partner filter and no longer fails when a vendor billing proposal exists. The fix is a small change in the Create Billing Documents codeunit, with new tests.
key_points: Create Documents on Recurring Billing now respects the Partner filter
Creating documents no longer fails when a vendor billing proposal exists
Small change in codeunit Create Billing Documents
New tests added in Recurring Billing Test
